title: Openness of bounded local fibre dimension on the source
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For $s\in S$ let $X_s$ be its scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. For $x\in X$, let $\widetilde x$ be the unique point of $X_{f(x)}$ mapping to $x$ under its projection to $X$, and let $\dim_{\widetilde x}X_{f(x)}$ be the topological dimension at that point [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point], namely the minimum of the Krull dimensions of its open neighbourhoods in the fibre. For every integer $n\geq0$, the subset $$U_n=\{x\in X\mid\dim_{\widetilde x}X_{f(x)}\leq n\}$$ is open in $X$. No properness, quasi-compactness, Noetherian, finite-presentation, or flatness hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Fix n and a point x of the bounded local fibre dimension locus. The local dimension is nonnegative: each open neighbourhood of the fibre point contains its singleton closure, a nonempty irreducible closed subset. Its assumed upper bound by n excludes infinity; nonnegativity excludes bottom. Case analysis in WithBot ℕ∞ therefore gives a natural number d equal to this local dimension, and d ≤ n.

Apply the existing theorem AlgebraicGeometry.exists_bounded_fibre_dimension_neighbourhood, promoted to public in its original module Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteTypeFibreDimensionBound, to x, d and the equality. It gives an open neighbourhood W of x with all local fibre dimensions bounded by d. This is exactly the affine-local argument of the original plan, reused without duplicate restriction or coordinate-comparison proofs.

For y in W the neighbourhood bound and d ≤ n give the defining inequality of the locus. Thus W is contained in the locus. Apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds and mem_nhds_iff to these open neighbourhoods. This also covers the empty locus because no point requires a neighbourhood.
